title: Protected Base Capture
description: Captures the exact protected base commit SHA used for later gate and PR evidence.

reason_codes.VERIFIED: Captured protected base matches the verified source of truth.
reason_codes.MISMATCH: Captured SHA does not match the verified source of truth.
reason_codes.STALE: Captured SHA is stale relative to the current task context.
reason_codes.DRIFTED: Protected base evidence drifted from the verified source of truth.
